title: DSPy Teleprompters and Optimizers
summary: This module provides various teleprompters and optimizers for DSPy programs, enabling automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and model fine-tuning strategies to improve program performance. It includes techniques like evolutionary reflection (GEPA), multi-candidate instruction/demo search (MIPROv2), and reinforcement learning-based optimization (GRPO).

nodes.label: Iteratively Refine Instructions
nodes.title: Avatar Optimizer
nodes.description: An optimizer that refines program instructions by comparing positive and negative examples and generating feedback for improvement.

nodes.label: Analyze Program Performance
nodes.title: Performance Comparator
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that analyzes good and bad program execution traces to identify patterns and suggest tool modifications.

nodes.label: Generate New Instructions
nodes.title: Instruction Generator
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that incorporates feedback into existing instructions to produce refined guidelines for a program.

nodes.label: Chain Multiple Optimizers
nodes.title: Meta-Optimizer for Chaining
nodes.description: A meta-optimizer that combines prompt and weight optimization by applying other Teleprompters in configurable sequences, allowing iterative improvement of prompts and model parameters.

nodes.label: Capture Program Execution Trace
nodes.title: Execution Trace Capturer
nodes.description: A modified forward method to capture detailed execution traces of a DSPy program, including handling parsing errors and assigning format rewards.

nodes.label: Iteratively Optimize Prompts
nodes.title: COPRO Prompt Optimizer
nodes.description: An optimizer that iteratively generates and evaluates prompt instructions and output prefixes, exploring a breadth of candidates and refining them over depth using a prompt model.

nodes.label: Propose Initial Prompt Instructions
nodes.title: Initial Prompt Proposer
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by COPRO to generate initial improved instructions and output field prefixes for a given basic instruction.

nodes.label: Refine Instructions from Past Attempts
nodes.title: Instruction Refiner from Attempts
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by COPRO to propose new instructions based on a history of attempted instructions and their validation scores.

nodes.label: Evolve Prompts with Reflection
nodes.title: GEPA Evolutionary Optimizer
nodes.description: An evolutionary optimizer that uses reflection to evolve text components (prompts) of DSPy modules. It analyzes execution traces and textual feedback to propose new instructions.

nodes.label: Define GEPA Feedback Logic
nodes.title: GEPA Metric Protocol
nodes.description: A protocol defining the metric function signature for GEPA, allowing it to receive scores and optional textual feedback for program and predictor execution traces.

nodes.label: Propose Multi-Modal Instructions for GEPA
nodes.title: GEPA Multi-Modal Proposer
nodes.description: A GEPA-compatible instruction proposer that handles multimodal inputs (e.g., dspy.Image) by generating new instructions for components based on reflective datasets.

nodes.label: Enhance Multi-Modal Instructions from Feedback
nodes.title: Enhanced Multi-Modal Instruction Generator
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature to generate improved instructions for multimodal tasks, specifically addressing visual analysis and integration issues identified in feedback.

nodes.label: Optimize with Reinforcement Learning
nodes.title: GRPO Finetune Optimizer
nodes.description: A finetune teleprompter that uses Gradient-based Reinforcement Learning for Program Optimization. It collects execution traces, assigns rewards, and updates LMs to improve performance.

nodes.label: Induce Natural Language Rules
nodes.title: Rule Induction Optimizer
nodes.description: An optimizer that extends BootstrapFewShot to induce natural language rules from examples, generating and evaluating candidate programs with these refined instructions.

nodes.label: Extract Rules from Examples
nodes.title: Custom Rule Extractor
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by InferRules to extract concise and actionable natural language rules from a given set of examples.

nodes.label: Select Few-Shot Demos via KNN
nodes.title: KNN Few-Shot Selector
nodes.description: An optimizer that dynamically selects k nearest neighbor examples from a training set at test time, attaching them as demonstrations to the student module.

nodes.label: Optimize Prompts & Demos with Bayesian Search
nodes.title: MIPROv2 Optimizer
nodes.description: A multi-candidate instruction and few-shot example optimizer that uses Bayesian Optimization to find the optimal combination of instructions and demonstrations for a DSPy program.

nodes.label: Optimize with Self-Reflective Rules & Demos
nodes.title: SIMBA Optimizer
nodes.description: A Stochastic Introspective Mini-Batch Ascent optimizer that uses an LLM to analyze its performance, generating improvement rules or adding successful examples as demonstrations.

nodes.label: Generate & Append Improvement Rule
nodes.title: SIMBA Rule Appender
nodes.description: A utility function used by SIMBA to generate a new natural language rule based on contrasting better and worse program trajectories and append it to a predictor's instructions.

nodes.label: Append Successful Demonstration
nodes.title: SIMBA Demo Appender
nodes.description: A utility function used by SIMBA to add a successful example from a program's execution trace as a demonstration to the relevant predictor.

nodes.label: Generate Module-Specific Feedback for SIMBA
nodes.title: SIMBA Feedback Generator
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature used by SIMBA to generate concrete, generalizable advice for individual modules by contrasting better and worse program execution trajectories.

nodes.label: Optimize Few-Shot Demos with Optuna
nodes.title: Optuna Few-Shot Optimizer
nodes.description: An optimizer that combines BootstrapFewShot with Optuna for hyperparameter optimization, searching for the best combination of bootstrapped few-shot demonstrations.

nodes.label: Retrieve Task Model History
nodes.title: Task Model History Retriever
nodes.description: A utility function to retrieve the full inspection history of a task language model for a given candidate program and evaluation setup.

nodes.label: Log Token Usage
nodes.title: Token Usage Logger
nodes.description: A utility function to extract and log the total input and output tokens used by various language models during a trial.

nodes.label: Calculate Proposed Program Quality
nodes.title: Program Quality Calculator
nodes.description: A utility function to calculate the average and best quality (score) of the last n proposed programs from trial logs, evaluating them on training and development sets.

nodes.label: DSPy Program/Module
nodes.title: DSPy Module
nodes.description: The core building block of a DSPy program, representing a sequence of operations or a single predictor.

nodes.label: Data Example
nodes.title: DSPy Example
nodes.description: A single input-output pair used for training, validation, or evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluate Program Performance
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluator
nodes.description: A utility for evaluating DSPy programs against a dataset using a specified metric.

nodes.label: Define LLM Interaction
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields for an LLM call, acting as a contract for its behavior.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: DSPy Language Model
nodes.description: Interface for interacting with various language models (e.g., GPT, Llama).

nodes.label: Embedding Model
nodes.title: DSPy Embedder
nodes.description: Interface for generating vector embeddings from text.

nodes.label: Hyperparameter Optimization Library
nodes.title: Optuna Library
nodes.description: An open-source hyperparameter optimization framework that automates the search for optimal hyperparameter values.

nodes.label: GEPA Evolutionary Optimization Library
nodes.title: GEPA Library
nodes.description: An external library providing the core evolutionary optimization engine for GEPA.

nodes.label: Parallel Program Execution
nodes.title: DSPy Parallel Executor
nodes.description: DSPy utility for executing programs or evaluations in parallel across multiple threads.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Few-Shot Demos
nodes.title: BootstrapFewShot Teleprompter
nodes.description: A teleprompter that bootstraps few-shot demonstrations for a program.

groups.label: Instruction & Rule Generation
groups.title: Instruction & Rule Generation
groups.description: Optimizers and components focused on creating, refining, and inducing instructions or explicit rules for DSPy predictors.

groups.label: Demonstration Management & Selection
groups.title: Demonstration Management & Selection
groups.description: Components dedicated to selecting, bootstrapping, and managing few-shot examples for DSPy programs.

groups.label: Meta & Finetuning Optimizers
groups.title: Meta & Finetuning Optimizers
groups.description: Advanced optimizers that orchestrate other optimization strategies or perform direct model finetuning.

groups.label: Utility & Monitoring
groups.title: Utility & Monitoring
groups.description: Helper functions for tracing program execution, logging resource usage, and calculating program quality metrics.
